title: Counter-Selector Wave 17: function-to-person attribution and external-review fan-out
purpose: Fan out the completed denominator into parallel, source-custodied lanes: attribute previously collective or checking-function residue to public-record people only where authorship or officeholder responsibility is explicit; prepare artifact-only external-review packets without contacting anyone; preserve identity blocks where the source does not name the operator; and open exact missing-receipt routes without creating a rank, promotion, field-test, public-profile, or graph effect.

person_traces.identity_basis: authored contemporaneous memorandum and named Presidential Commission testimony

support_assignments.basis: After new O-ring evidence invalidated the accepted flight posture, the authored memorandum called for immediate action, a formally empowered full-time team, and priority treatment of the field-joint failure mode.
support_assignments.ceiling: Escalating a failure mode and proposing a repair team does not prove control of the launch gate, completed repair, safe handoff, or capability outside the shuttle-seal problem.

support_assignments.basis: The memorandum explicitly states that the previously accepted position was drastically changed by later secondary O-ring erosion evidence and updates the risk model accordingly.
support_assignments.ceiling: One explicit evidence-driven update does not establish repeated elasticity under unrelated contradiction or a complete Counter-Selector operator.

support_assignments.basis: The warning separates observed erosion from a conditional field-joint scenario, preserves uncertainty about joint success or failure, and states the resulting human-life consequence without claiming omniscience.
support_assignments.ceiling: Accurate conditional risk language does not establish universal predictive capacity, support-adjusted surplus, or cross-domain transfer.

person_traces.identity_basis: named senior-contractor testimony before the Presidential Commission

support_assignments.basis: As the senior Thiokol representative at the launch site, McDonald accepted the no-launch engineering recommendation, raised cold O-ring and other launch hazards, and refused to sign written launch approval.
support_assignments.ceiling: Refusal under pressure does not establish control of the final launch decision, completed exception repair, safe handoff, or transfer beyond launch readiness.

support_assignments.basis: His testimony distinguishes inconclusive data from safety, explains why a calculation could inform but not automatically support launch, and repeatedly rejects interpretation of his comments as a launch endorsement.
support_assignments.ceiling: Careful testimony after the event is not an original handoff receipt, a support-adjusted-surplus finding, or repeated cross-domain epistemic performance.

person_traces.identity_basis: named Debris Assessment Team co-chair, attributable imagery-request email, and NASA-authored lessons-learned record

support_assignments.basis: When existing transport, thermal, trajectory, and structural analysis could not bound the damage, Rocha carried the team request for outside imagery and identified operational options that better evidence could inform.
support_assignments.ceiling: Requesting evidence and generating options does not prove the imagery would have enabled rescue, that Rocha controlled the Mission Management Team gate, or that the request was safely handed off.

support_assignments.basis: The request explicitly preserves a wide answer range from acceptable to horrible and states that existing analysis could not reduce uncertainty without clearer imagery.
support_assignments.ceiling: Preserving uncertainty in one mission does not establish support-adjusted surplus, model elasticity after personal disproof, or cross-domain transfer.

person_traces.identity_basis: public appointment as Inspector General and congressional attribution of the November 2023 OIG finding

support_assignments.basis: During Febles's term as Inspector General, the OIG issued a source-addressable statutory compliance report, preserved recommendations, and committed to track corrective action; congressional oversight attributed the independence finding to Febles.
support_assignments.ceiling: Officeholder responsibility for publication does not establish sole authorship of every audit procedure, independent successor handoff, implementation of recommendations, or support-adjusted surplus.

support_assignments.basis: The report applied statutory criteria, recorded compliance in most reviewed areas, isolated unresolved HR and procurement independence, and published that adverse finding while Febles held the checking office.
support_assignments.ceiling: A mixed statutory report under an officeholder does not establish universal person quality, retaliation merits, safe handoff, or capability beyond the bounded checking function.

identity_blocks.blocking_reason: The official Chemical Safety Board record describes the consultant and reproduces the warning but does not name the consultant in the acquired public source surface.
required_to_unblock: original consultant report with attributable author or firm

identity_blocks.blocked_identity_label: collective Liberty helicopter pilot warning function
identity_blocks.blocking_reason: The official accident and board records say Liberty pilots raised predicted hazards, but the acquired record does not isolate each original warning object, author, recipient acknowledgment, and handoff chain.
